Clock.description:
The set's clock: ticks at k * step_s for k = 0..=N, where N * step_s equals horizon_s
exactly in binary64. At most 16,777,216 ticks.

horizon_s.description: The last tick, in seconds: not negative, and a whole number of steps.

block.description:
The class path of the block that warns, for example "CDL.Utilities.Assert". A class, not
an instance.

message.description: The warning's message, matched byte for byte when present.

Expectation.description: One expectation, in exactly one of two forms: a window (output, from_s, to_s, equals) or an instant (diagnostic, at_s).

Input.description: What an input holds over the clock: one value for the whole run, or a step list of at least one step (at most 65,536) starting at t = 0.

Instant.description: An instant expectation: the frame at at_s emitted the diagnostic.

at_s.description: The time of the frame, in seconds: a tick of the clock.

diagnostic.description: The run-time warning expected at at_s.

Mutant.description: One mutant: where its CXF document is, relative to this file, and what defect it carries.

description.description: What the mutant changes, for people.

path.description:
The mutant's CXF document: a path inside this file's directory, its segments separated by
a slash, none empty, "." or "..", and no backslash. Unique in the set.

Scenario.description: One scenario: what every input holds over the clock, and what is expected of the outputs.

description.description: What the scenario shows, for people.

expect.description: The expectations, in order. At most 4,096.

inputs.description:
Input name to what it holds: a constant, or a step list. Every input of the sequence has
exactly one entry.

name.description: The scenario name: not empty, unique in the set.

params.description: Parameter edits for this scenario only: parameter path to value. At most 256 entries.

Step.description: One step of a step list: from time t on, the input holds value (zero-order hold).

t.description:
The time in seconds from which the value holds. The first step is at 0, each later one is
after the one before it, and none is after horizon_s. It need not be a tick: it takes
effect at the first tick at or after it.

Value.description: A value: a number or a boolean. A number written without a fraction or exponent is an integer token, and only an integer token is taken by an Integer port or parameter; a Real takes any number.

Window.description:
A window expectation: the output equals the value at every tick from from_s to to_s, both
ends included.

equals.description: The value the output must equal, exactly; a Real is compared by its bits.

from_s.description: The first second of the window: not negative, not after to_s.

to_s.description:
The last second of the window: not after horizon_s. The window must hold at least one
tick.

description:
A vector set: scenarios (inputs over one clock, expectations over windows of it) to check
against one loaded control sequence. Strict JSON: every object is closed, no key repeats, and
a key this schema does not define is refused, never ignored.

clock.description: The set's clock. Every scenario runs on it.

mutants.description:
Mutants: CXF documents that should fail the vectors, each a deliberate defect in the
sequence, scored only when the sequence itself passes. At most 256, in order.

params.description:
Parameter edits applied to every scenario before its first frame: parameter path to
value. At most 256 entries. A scenario's own params override these.

scenarios.description: The scenarios, in order. At most 4,096; each runs on a freshly loaded sequence.

title: VectorSet
